SELECT factory_code, root_material_code, terminal_material_code, terminal_type, supply_mode, source_month FROM mrp_daily_plan_detail WHERE GROUP BY factory_code, root_material_code, terminal_material_code, terminal_type, supply_mode, source_month ORDER BY factory_code, root_material_code, source_month, terminal_material_code, terminal_type, supply_mode LIMIT #{offset},#{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM mrp_daily_plan_detail WHERE GROUP BY factory_code, root_material_code, terminal_material_code, terminal_type, supply_mode, source_month) rows_count

SELECT * FROM mrp_daily_plan_detail WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND
(factory_code=#{r.factoryCode} AND root_material_code=#{r.rootMaterialCode} AND terminal_material_code=#{r.terminalMaterialCode} AND terminal_type=#{r.terminalType} AND supply_mode=#{r.supplyMode} AND source_month=#{r.sourceMonth})
ORDER BY factory_code, root_material_code, terminal_material_code, source_month, schedule_date, id
SELECT * FROM mrp_daily_plan_detail WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND terminal_type='MACHINE_OUTPUT' ORDER BY id

SELECT factory_code,root_material_code,root_material_code terminal_material_code, 'MACHINE_OUTPUT' terminal_type,'SELF_MADE' supply_mode FROM mrp_daily_plan_detail WHERE GROUP BY factory_code,root_material_code ORDER BY factory_code,root_material_code LIMIT #{offset},#{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM mrp_daily_plan_detail WHERE GROUP BY factory_code,root_material_code) grouped

SELECT * FROM mrp_daily_plan_detail WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND terminal_type='MACHINE_OUTPUT' AND
(factory_code=#{r.factoryCode} AND root_material_code=#{r.rootMaterialCode})
ORDER BY factory_code,root_material_code,source_month,schedule_date,id
mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN mrp_daily_plan_override o ON o.batch_id=#{batchId} AND o.factory_code=d.factory_code AND o.root_material_code=d.root_material_code AND o.terminal_material_code=d.terminal_material_code AND o.terminal_type=d.terminal_type AND o.supply_mode=d.supply_mode AND o.path_group_key=d.path_group_key AND o.schedule_date=d.schedule_date WHERE d.run_id=#{runId} AND COALESCE(o.manual_quantity,d.system_quantity) > 0

SELECT NULL id,d.run_id,d.batch_id,d.factory_code,d.root_material_code,d.terminal_material_code,d.terminal_type, d.supply_mode,d.path_group_key,d.source_month, CASE WHEN #{rolling} THEN o.schedule_date ELSE DATE_ADD(o.schedule_date,INTERVAL 7 DAY) END source_date, o.schedule_date,0 system_quantity,o.manual_quantity effective_quantity,TRUE is_production_day,o.revision, SHA2(CONCAT(d.factory_code,'|',d.root_material_code,'|',d.terminal_material_code,'|',d.terminal_type,'|',d.supply_mode,'|',d.path_group_key,'|',d.source_month,'|',o.schedule_date),256) row_key

FROM mrp_daily_plan_override o JOIN mrp_daily_plan_detail d ON d.run_id=#{runId} AND d.factory_code=o.factory_code AND d.root_material_code=o.root_material_code AND d.terminal_material_code=o.terminal_material_code AND d.terminal_type=o.terminal_type AND d.supply_mode=o.supply_mode AND d.path_group_key=o.path_group_key WHERE o.batch_id=#{batchId} AND o.manual_quantity > 0
AND d.id=(SELECT MIN(t.id) FROM mrp_daily_plan_detail t WHERE t.run_id=d.run_id AND t.factory_code=d.factory_code AND t.root_material_code=d.root_material_code AND t.terminal_material_code=d.terminal_material_code AND t.terminal_type=d.terminal_type AND t.supply_mode=d.supply_mode AND t.path_group_key=d.path_group_key) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mrp_daily_plan_detail t WHERE t.run_id=d.run_id AND t.factory_code=d.factory_code AND t.root_material_code=d.root_material_code AND t.terminal_material_code=d.terminal_material_code AND t.terminal_type=d.terminal_type AND t.supply_mode=d.supply_mode AND t.path_group_key=d.path_group_key AND t.schedule_date=o.schedule_date)
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mrp_daily_plan_override WHERE batch_id=#{batchId})
mapper.sql: FROM mrp_daily_plan_detail d WHERE d.run_id=#{runId} AND d.system_quantity > 0

choose.when: SELECT d.id,d.run_id,d.batch_id,d.factory_code,d.root_material_code,d.terminal_material_code,d.terminal_type, d.supply_mode,d.path_group_key,d.source_month,d.source_date,d.schedule_date,d.system_quantity, d.system_quantity effective_quantity,d.is_production_day,-1 revision,d.row_key FROM (SELECT d.id ORDER BY LIMIT #{offset},#{pageSize}) page_ids JOIN mrp_daily_plan_detail d ON d.id=page_ids.id ORDER BY

SELECT CASE WHEN p.is_virtual=1 THEN NULL ELSE d.id END id, d.run_id,d.batch_id,d.factory_code,d.root_material_code,d.terminal_material_code,d.terminal_type, d.supply_mode,d.path_group_key,d.source_month, CASE WHEN p.is_virtual=1 THEN CASE WHEN #{rolling} THEN p.schedule_date ELSE DATE_ADD(p.schedule_date,INTERVAL 7 DAY) END ELSE d.source_date END source_date, p.schedule_date,CASE WHEN p.is_virtual=1 THEN CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,6)) ELSE d.system_quantity END system_quantity, COALESCE(o.manual_quantity,d.system_quantity) effective_quantity, CASE WHEN p.is_virtual=1 THEN TRUE ELSE d.is_production_day END is_production_day, COALESCE(o.revision,-1) revision, CASE WHEN p.is_virtual=1 THEN SHA2(CONCAT(d.factory_code,'|',d.root_material_code,'|',d.terminal_material_code,'|',d.terminal_type,'|', d.supply_mode,'|',d.path_group_key,'|',d.source_month,'|',p.schedule_date),256) ELSE d.row_key END row_key
FROM (SELECT padded_keys.detail_id,padded_keys.override_id,padded_keys.is_virtual,padded_keys.schedule_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY schedule_date,source_month, RPAD(WEIGHT_STRING(factory_code),factory_code_weight_size,WEIGHT_STRING(_utf8mb4' ' COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci)),RPAD(WEIGHT_STRING(root_material_code),root_material_code_weight_size,WEIGHT_STRING(_utf8mb4' ' COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci)), RPAD(WEIGHT_STRING(terminal_material_code),terminal_material_code_weight_size,WEIGHT_STRING(_utf8mb4' ' COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci)),RPAD(WEIGHT_STRING(path_group_key),path_group_key_weight_size,WEIGHT_STRING(_utf8mb4' ' COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci)), RPAD(WEIGHT_STRING(terminal_type),terminal_type_weight_size,WEIGHT_STRING(_utf8mb4' ' COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci)),RPAD(WEIGHT_STRING(supply_mode),supply_mode_weight_size,WEIGHT_STRING(_utf8mb4' ' COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci))) page_position FROM (SELECT page_keys.*, MAX(OCTET_LENGTH(WEIGHT_STRING(factory_code))) OVER () factory_code_weight_size, MAX(OCTET_LENGTH(WEIGHT_STRING(root_material_code))) OVER () root_material_code_weight_size, MAX(OCTET_LENGTH(WEIGHT_STRING(terminal_material_code))) OVER () terminal_material_code_weight_size, MAX(OCTET_LENGTH(WEIGHT_STRING(path_group_key))) OVER () path_group_key_weight_size, MAX(OCTET_LENGTH(WEIGHT_STRING(terminal_type))) OVER () terminal_type_weight_size, MAX(OCTET_LENGTH(WEIGHT_STRING(supply_mode))) OVER () supply_mode_weight_size FROM ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT d.id detail_id,o.id override_id,0 is_virtual,d.schedule_date,d.source_month,d.factory_code, d.root_material_code,d.terminal_material_code,d.path_group_key,d.terminal_type,d.supply_mode FROM mrp_daily_plan_detail d FORCE INDEX (idx_mdpd_run_detail_order)
ORDER BY d.schedule_date,d.source_month,d.factory_code,d.root_material_code,d.terminal_material_code, d.path_group_key,d.terminal_type,d.supply_mode LIMIT #{storedOffset},#{windowSize} ) stored_window UNION ALL SELECT d.id detail_id,o.id override_id,1 is_virtual,o.schedule_date,d.source_month,d.factory_code, d.root_material_code,d.terminal_material_code,d.path_group_key,d.terminal_type,d.supply_mode
) page_keys) padded_keys) p STRAIGHT_JOIN mrp_daily_plan_detail d ON d.id=p.detail_id LEFT JOIN mrp_daily_plan_override o ON o.id=p.override_id WHERE p.page_position > #{mergeOffset} AND p.page_position <= #{windowSize} ORDER BY p.page_position

mapper.select: SELECT factory_code, schedule_date, 'MACHINE_OUTPUT' terminal_type, SUM(effective_quantity) effective_quantity FROM () effective GROUP BY factory_code,schedule_date
